sources.snippet: Overview distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english is a text classification model fine-tuned by distilbert for sentiment analysis on the Stanford Sentiment Treebank 2 (SST-2) dataset. The model achieves 91.3% accuracy on the SST-2 dev set, compared to 92.7% for the full BERT base model. Built on DistilBERT architecture, this model compresses BERT through knowledge distillation ...
